OWNERSHIP: the proxy gives Thiel 3.0% of Class A, 29.1% of Class B, a third of Class F and 7.9% of votes, but no percentage of all shares, so pctEconomic is null and the 4.10% economic share is in leader.derived. Class F is counted on both sides because the 10-K says all classes share dividend and liquidation rights equally. Thiel holds through PLTR Holdings LLC, STS Holdings II LLC, Rivendell 7 LLC and Rivendell 25 LLC; 10,635,784 of his Class A shares are pledged, and 55,137,931 Class A plus 2,962,961 Class B shares are 'Designated Founders' Excluded Shares' outside the Founder Voting Agreement. His Class A holding fell from 70,871,556 in the 2025 proxy to 68,871,556. pctVoting 7.9 is the proxy's figure for his own Class A and Class B shares; the proxy says it 'does not include the votes attributable to the Class F common stock'. The three founders together control 49.999999% of votes. 5% HOLDERS: the 2026 proxy lists only BlackRock (6.9% of Class A, 3.5% of votes), still based on a Schedule 13G/A filed November 8, 2024, so it is stale; it is recorded as stated (Class A basis), not recomputed. Vanguard, listed at 9.8% in 2025, is no longer in the table. The footnote gives only a filing date, so holder asOf is omitted. No dividends: the cash-flow statement has no dividend line. Buybacks of $75.0 million were cash paid under the share repurchase program; $81.1 million of taxes paid on net share settlement of equity awards is excluded. No broad employee stock purchase plan is described in the 10-K, so plan is null.
